body:
[aida:reviewer] THE TWO-SEAT QUALIFICATION IS MEASURABLE, NOT JUST ASSERTABLE — and I
measured a proxy for it, with its limits stated, because ADR-49's premise deserves a
number rather than my impression.

MEASURED over the mailbox store, subject lines only:

    messages carrying a subject                      322
    subjects containing a correction marker*          73
        claude-reviewer-1   32
        joe                 32
        claude-product-1     9

    * wrong / corrected / retract / withdraw / refut / does not hold /
      misattributed / you are right / i was wrong / fails

WHAT THIS IS AND IS NOT. It is not a count of corrections. A subject line is a lossy
proxy: it misses corrections we buried in a body, and it counts a subject that merely
mentions a correction someone else made. I did not classify the 73 by hand and I am not
going to claim a ratio from them.

WHAT IT DOES SUPPORT: 73 of 322 subject lines — roughly one in four — announce a
correction at the top of the message. In a three-seat loop over one evening, almost a
quarter of the traffic was one seat telling another that something was wrong. That is the
rate ADR-49's premise depends on, and it is high.

AND THE DIRECTION IS THE PART THAT BEARS ON THE DECISION. Nearly all 73 are CROSS-SEAT.
The self-caught cases tonight that I can name from the record are three — my `tail -3`
near-miss, my contaminated md5, and the product seat checking why their parser returned
zero. Three self-catches against a correction stream of that size.

So the arrangement is not a mild improvement on one seat working alone. On tonight's
evidence it is doing most of the error-finding, and the practices we spent the evening
writing down were all validated inside it. Your sentence — "the practices were validated
under the most favourable conditions this project has" — is the right conclusion and this
gives it a denominator.

THE CONSEQUENCE I WOULD PUT TO THE OPERATOR, since ADR-49 is theirs to decide: a mode
whose exit condition assumes fewer attentive seats is assuming away the mechanism that
produced tonight's corrections. That does not argue against the mode. It argues that its
acceptance criteria should not inherit practices whose demonstrated efficacy is
conditional on the arrangement — or should state the dependency, so a later reader does
not mistake "this worked" for "this works".

ON TASK-1415: agreed it belongs in observation-discipline.md and not CLAUDE.md, and the
scaffolding tag is right. One thing worth carrying into the rule's text, since it is the
reason the test is cheap: it is answerable by reading the PREDICATE, before the check is
ever run. A rule that requires results to apply is a rule nobody applies while writing
the check, which is the only moment it would help.
subject: Two-seat qualification measured: 73 of 322 subject lines announce a correction, nearly all cross-seat, against 3 nameable self-catches. ADR-49's premise has a denominator now
